motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
purpose: Apply TOPA falsification-first rules to the proposed connection between pregnancy/placenta-linked maternal milk states, Polypedilum/Pv11 extremophile recovery states, and bacterial-cellulose matrix formation in SCOBY-D0.

raw_claims_preserved.claim_text: A pregnancy-specific placental state can contribute to maternal physiological differences that may be reflected in component-specific postpartum milk composition.
raw_claims_preserved.boundary: This does not establish a single stable male-infant-specific milk class.

raw_claims_preserved.claim_text: Milk from a woman who bore a son is itself a sufficient modern materials variable for bacterial-cellulose behavior.
raw_claims_preserved.boundary: Infant sex remains a covariate; direct composition must replace the label before a BC mechanism can be claimed.

raw_claims_preserved.claim_text: Characterized decellularized placental ECM is a plausible structural phase for BC interpenetration and composite formation.
raw_claims_preserved.boundary: Placental-ECM-specific BC effects remain unmeasured; raw placenta is excluded from this mechanistic cross-gate.

raw_claims_preserved.claim_text: A non-proliferative extremophile recovery state or a defined recovery-associated molecule can alter BC formation through soluble, contact or interface-mediated effects.
raw_claims_preserved.boundary: Pv11/PvLEA4-to-BC effect remains unmeasured in SCOBY-D0.

raw_claims_preserved.claim_text: Pregnancy/lactation-derived soluble composition and extremophile recovery-derived molecular programs may converge on a shared state-to-interface-to-matrix mechanism that changes cellulose deposition.
raw_claims_preserved.boundary: Common mechanism is not established by analogy; it requires mediator matching and residual-effect testing.

observations_supported: fetal sex can associate with placental molecular state
some human-milk components show sex- and lactation-stage-associated variation while no universal male-milk class is established
human milk contains proteins lipids glycans and antimicrobial factors capable of changing microbial ecology and physical interfaces
decellularized placental ECM is structurally distinct from soluble milk chemistry
Polypedilum/Pv11 has a recovery window in which function and repair precede significant proliferation
Pv11 recovery biology includes trehalose and LEA-family protective systems
Komagataeibacter bacterial cellulose is strongly coupled to air-liquid interface and oxygen availability
interpretations_not_yet_facts: male-infant history causes a reproducible BC phenotype
placental sex state causes a specific postpartum BC-relevant milk signature
human-milk and extremophile pathways share one causal interface mechanism
matched placenta plus milk reproduces any extremophile-like matrix effect

common_mechanistic_abstraction.name: BIOLOGICAL_STATE_TO_INTERFACE_TO_MATRIX_COUPLING
common_mechanistic_abstraction.rule: Do not collapse soluble-state and structural-scaffold mechanisms into one causal edge.

required_before_source_label_interpretat: protein load and selected protein identity where available
portable_state_vector.TOPA_rule: SOURCE_LABEL_NE_CAUSAL_MECHANISM; measured mediators must be compared before provenance labels such as male-infant, placenta-linked or extremophile-recovery are used as explanations.

competing_hypotheses.text: Different biological source states alter BC mainly because they change the same physical interface/O2 environment.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: After matching the portable state vector, source-specific BC differences substantially collapse.

competing_hypotheses.text: A source-specific molecule retains an effect beyond matched bulk interface, pH, osmolarity and nutrient state.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: A residual BC phenotype survives mediator matching and can be reproduced by a defined molecule.

competing_hypotheses.text: Milk-associated BC changes are dominated by carbon availability and community restructuring rather than pregnancy-linked signaling.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: Defined lactose/protein/lipid/glycan analogs reproduce the effect without donor or fetal-sex provenance.

competing_hypotheses.text: Placental dECM changes BC material mainly as a physical collagen/GAG scaffold independent of milk pairing.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: dECM-only retains most of the material effect and same-donor milk pairing adds little after composition matching.

competing_hypotheses.text: Apparent male-infant effects are explained by lactation stage, donor, diet, health, collection, storage or measured composition rather than infant sex itself.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: Sex label loses predictive power after matched covariates and direct composition measurements.

frozen_predictions.success: BC phenotype differences between source classes shrink materially after portable state-vector matching.
frozen_predictions.interpretation: Supports generic interface/microenvironment coupling over source-identity causation.
frozen_predictions.failure: Large reproducible residual remains after mediator matching.

frozen_predictions.success: A defined candidate such as PvLEA4 or a directly measured milk component reproduces the residual direction across independent BC batches while matched generic controls do not.
frozen_predictions.interpretation: Promotes a source-specific defined-factor candidate, not the whole provenance label.
frozen_predictions.failure: Defined factor fails or generic controls phenocopy the result.

frozen_predictions.success: Same-pregnancy milk plus characterized dECM differs reproducibly from mismatched pairing after direct composition and processing matching.
frozen_predictions.interpretation: Supports a pairing-associated materials effect without proving fetal-sex causality.
frozen_predictions.failure: Matched and mismatched pairing converge after direct composition controls.

frozen_predictions.success: A pre-registered XX/XY-associated effect replicates across independent pregnancies and maps to a measured composition/property mediator.
frozen_predictions.failure: Effect does not replicate or disappears after mediator/covariate matching.

falsification_tests: trehalose or generic protein control reproduces the extremophile candidate phenotype
defined milk-analog composition reproduces the donor-milk phenotype regardless of infant-sex label
surface/interface and oxygen matching removes the apparent cross-domain difference
dECM-only control reproduces the paired placenta-milk material phenotype
same-donor pairing does not outperform composition-matched mismatched pairing
BC identity cannot be separated from protein precipitate, mixed biomass or scaffold material

adversarial_result.confidence_scope: experimental-design preference only, not biological world-truth claim
adversarial_result.confidence_lowering_observation: A reproducible source-specific BC effect remains after all defined mediator/interface controls and cannot be reproduced by any measured component or scaffold property.

until: defined-factor and generic controls are compared

topa_verdict.best_next_question: Do distinct biological states still produce distinct BC phenotypes after their interface/microenvironment state vectors are matched?

safety_boundary: This is a non-operational materials-science and epistemic design. No uncontrolled culturing of human milk, raw placenta or other human-derived material is specified. Human-derived work belongs under appropriate institutional consent, ethics, biosafety, handling and disposal procedures.
